headline: root-foundation is the one live study, and the layout rule sends every study step there. It has 9,163 tracked files and about 4.3M words: a 510-section study log that 411 of 567 records cite, a generated mirror, and 240 study folders in development/ with no index. It is mostly trace and machine output, but it is wired in. Tools read data inside about 10 study folders, live pages hold 535 anchored links into it, and record counterexamples and the direction page's provenance point to its reader rounds. Only about 1% of its long lines repeat the account word for word.

loadBearingClaims.claim: The area has 9,163 tracked files (220 MB). development/ has 8,333 files in 240 tracked study folders and 2,673,679 Markdown words; the whole area has 4,315,249 Markdown words. No index of development/ exists and none was ever committed.
loadBearingClaims.evidence: git ls-files counts; wc -w over git ls-files md; git log on development/INDEX.md and MANIFEST.json returns nothing; no files at depth 6

loadBearingClaims.claim: 411 of 567 record JSONs cite BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING.md. 490 mention some area path (excluding history/root-foundation). 16 record counterexample paths point into the area, 4 of them at wu-a-way-of-units/readers/ reports.
loadBearingClaims.evidence: python walk of theories/becoming/results/records/*.json for the area prefix

loadBearingClaims.claim: Live tools have hard-coded paths into study folders. gate.py, theory_graph.py, atlas.py, atlas_index.py, spine.py, completion.py and two tests read files in review-packet, one-unfolding-root, ou2-candidates, ou7-conditional-laws, ou3b, aa-attractor-atlas, map-structures, u4-one-root-to-its-edge, rw-spine, zhonghua, y1-changes and ro-relational-sources, plus THEOREM-CONNECTIVITY*. Moving those folders breaks tools unless the tools change first.
loadBearingClaims.howFarSeen: counted by rg; code read as text only, not run

loadBearingClaims.claim: The 680-page mirror is generated by tools/research/mirror.py. 28,595 of its 31,314 non-empty lines (91.3%) are verbatim in BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING{,.zh}.md.
loadBearingClaims.evidence: line-set comparison script; mirror README header; generated-manifest lists 680 mirror files

loadBearingClaims.claim: Only about 1% of the area's long prose repeats the live account word for word. Of Markdown lines of 80 characters or more, 1.1% in development/, 0.4% at the top level and 0.5% in the mirror appear verbatim in theories/becoming (non-history), DIRECTION.md or Becoming/*.lean.
212 of the 468 .lean files in development/ are byte-identical to a tracked file under LEAN/. Of all 9,163 area files, only 276 are byte-identical to any file outside the area.

113 of the 240 studies are cited by a hand-kept live file (records, chapters, account pages, board, _process top pages, tools, Lean, root pages). 36 are cited by no live or generated file. 8 are cited only by themselves.
loadBearingClaims.evidence: rg --no-ignore-dot -o 'development/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+' over the tree minus tmp/, classified by citing path; history and architecture/history excluded
loadBearingClaims.howFarSeen: counted; the live classes are this reader's choice

loadBearingClaims.claim: Failed candidates are kept here and were not found elsewhere. xr-exchange-root/PLAN.md (superseded root: exchange presupposes two parties) is cited by nothing live, and its reason was not found elsewhere in a tree sweep. dj second-way-2026-11-17 holds a guess that mostly failed, with two scratch Lean modules outside the package. ou2-candidates/outcomes.tsv holds 3 refuted and 2 misclassified readings, read by theory_graph.py.
loadBearingClaims.evidence: rg sweep for the phrase; NOTE.md read; outcomes.tsv counted
loadBearingClaims.howFarSeen: sampled 3 studies; 18 studies name a countermodel (counted)

againstTheViews: Against Ren's 'garbage': the prose is not a copy of the account (about 1% verbatim). It holds the failed candidates and the reader checks of prose against the Lean that records' counterexamples and DIRECTION's provenance cite.

Against the coordinator's 'trace can leave without loss': it can leave the reading path, but not the tool path or the link graph. There are 535 anchored links from live pages, 411 records pinned to one log file, and generators reading data stored inside trace folders. Kinds would have to be separated before any move.
The 16 October restructure planned a development/INDEX.md and MANIFEST.json and a top level of about 150 files. The top level is now 98 files, but development/ grew to 8,333 files with no index.
The layout rule itself drives growth: every study step lands here, and retirement copies byte for byte into history/root-foundation (4,362 files).
